entries.text: MCP prompts and server instructions now name only registered tools and real arguments, tell the model to call validate_results before reporting a run, and state when two results are comparable.

MCP run_benchmark and start_benchmark accept seed and iterations with the same meaning and defaults as the CLI --seed and --iterations options, report the effective values in mcp_metadata, and remote servers bound iterations with the new max_iterations policy setting (default 10).
